title: The Toy That Moves by Itself

collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — BEYOND THE HORIZON, EVENTS 081 to 130 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more speculative branching events continuing "Isola — Beyond the Horizon" (001-080), in the same format: EVENT nnn — TITLE, SETUP, choices A/B/C, two mutually exclusive outcomes per choice, and an optional "Content note:".

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: Spinning a top, a child wonders whether distant children might have toys that move without anyone pushing them.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Spinning a top, (name1), a child, wonders whether distant children might have toys that move without anyone pushing them.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The children imagine wooden animals that walk on their own and squeal with delight.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A builder sketches tiny wheels and wound cords, and wonders if it could work.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: An elder suggests distant children might love tops and string figures just as much.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A child decides the best toys are the ones you make yourself.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: A carver builds a little boat that drifts across the lagoon on a sail, and the children call it a toy that moves by itself.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The attempt fails, and the children happily play with the pieces.
